methodology: Ponytail Review + UI/UX Pro Max forensic audit across all 6 candidate directions (48 conceptual surfaces). Systematic elimination of generic-template tropes, vibe-coded artifacts, and anti-patterns.

rejected_patterns.description: Purple/cyan glowing gradients or 'sparkle magic' icons representing AI itinerary generation.
rejected_patterns.rationale: Violates Anti-Vibe-Code constraints. AI is a deterministic planning instrument solving constraints, not a magical mystical chatbot.

rejected_patterns.description: Star rating displays ('4.8 ★ (1,240 reviews)') and commercial booking review summaries.
rejected_patterns.rationale: Violates truth boundary. O-TRAVELZ does not collect commercial reviews. Verification is based on official administrative provenance.

rejected_patterns.description: Stacking 10+ translucent floating glass pill buttons across the map and discover screens.
rejected_patterns.rationale: Causes visual clutter ('pill pollution'), fails outdoor contrast in bright coastal sun, and confuses TalkBack/VoiceOver focus traversal.

rejected_patterns.description: Hotel search boxes, 'Book Now' CTAs, urgency counters ('Only 2 spots left!'), and price tags.
rejected_patterns.rationale: O-TRAVELZ is a Modern Odisha Cultural Atlas, not a booking aggregator. Fares are null until official CRUT tables are ingested.

rejected_patterns.description: Opening modal bottom sheets for simple settings, forms, filter changes, and search results.
rejected_patterns.rationale: Destroys navigation back-stack clarity. Sheets are reserved for transient inspections (map place preview, transit stop departures); full flows use NavigationStack / NavigationBar.

rejected_patterns.description: Heavy multi-layer image parallax scroll headers that consume GPU cycles without conveying information.
rejected_patterns.rationale: Causes frame drops on entry-level target hardware (Vivo Y19 / Helio P65). Media must be presented cleanly as verified evidence.

rejected_patterns.description: Animated bus icons moving continuously along route polylines simulating live vehicle positions.
rejected_patterns.rationale: CRITICAL REPOSITORY RULE VIOLATION: Zero vehicle telemetry exists. Scheduled timetable departures must never be presented as live GPS tracking.

rejected_patterns.description: Relying purely on a green or yellow dot without accompanying text to indicate verification status.
rejected_patterns.rationale: Fails WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility for color-blind travelers. Every status badge must combine distinct icon shapes with explicit textual labels.

rejected_patterns.description: Forcing Android to use iOS hairline lists or forcing iOS to use Android Material floating action buttons.
rejected_patterns.rationale: Violates Dual-Native contract. Android must feel like pure Material 3; iOS must feel like pure Apple HIG.

rejected_patterns.description: Keeping full-screen MapKit camera actively rendering and tracking in foreground throughout walking trips.
rejected_patterns.rationale: Severe battery drain during full-day travel. Active Trip must prioritize low-power structured timeline lists, delegating live turn-by-turn to external maps.

preserved_patterns_keep.description: Integrated tonal/capsule badges with explicit text: [● Verified Official], [◷ Scheduled · HH:MM], [☁ Live · 31°C].
Standardized walking feasibility indicators based on Haversine distance bands (<=800m, 800-1500m, >1500m).
Anchoring primary interactive targets in the bottom 40% of the screen for safe transit and walking use.
Instant single-tap access to 211 verified civic utilities and emergency phone numbers.
